The Cheba Man clip shows a dancer on a festival stage above a packed night crowd, throwing Tecktonik arm waves on every beat while everyone below holds up their phones. It spread as a "main character" moment, and the AI trend puts you on that stage.

faq: How do I make the Cheba Man AI video?
Open this page. The Cheba Man clip is already loaded. Add one photo, then click Generate.
How much does the Cheba Man AI video cost?
The 20-second clip at 480p costs 1,054 credits (about $10.54). 720p and 1080p are sharper and cost more. No subscription.
Who goes where?
Your photo replaces the dancer on the stage. The crowd below stays as it is.
What photos work best?
A clear, front-facing, well-lit photo of one person. Avoid group photos and heavy shadows. Only use photos of people who agreed to be in the video.
Can I use a different clip?
Yes. Use the Custom trend page to upload any MP4 between 4 and 30 seconds with your own photos and prompt.
